description: Pedestrian infrastructure is a series of datasets listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Municipal infrastructure dedicated to pedestrians.This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate). Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are HackQC24, V1 standard pedestrian infrastructure, Pedestrian, Transport, infrastructure. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, JSON, KML. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
